newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Petrofina soars on dollar, results fallout.
newsitem.headline: Petrofina soars on dollar, results fallout.

text.p: Shares in Belgian oil group Petrofina SA jumped five percent on Tuesday, mainly on a strong dollar, belated fallout from solid earnings and a recent Angolan oil find report by French rival Elf-Aquitaine, analysts said.
KB-Securities analyst Ruth Devenyns said the recent negative bourse climate had smothered the impact of 1996 earnings.
"Now that things are going better again, shares like Petrofina, which fundamentally have something more to offer, will start outperforming," she said.
At 1315 GMT Petrofina was up 4.2 percent at 12,500 francs, after earlier touching 12,600 francs, with a relatively high 29,594 shares traded.

Elf said last week it struck oil at a second tier in the Girassol oil field in Angola. It said earlier on Tuesday that the well was capable of becoming the country's most productive single deep-water well.
"Petrofina also has interests in Angola and could be supported by such a major find by a competitor," Devenyns said.
